content.short: Governance by Grape is a fast Solana gateway to DAOs and Web3 governance tooling.
content.description: Governance by Grape offers a fast, scalable DAO tooling infrastructure built to enhance the Solana governance experience. It gives users quick access to historical data and enables extraction of important governance metrics that were previously hard to obtain efficiently. As a powerful Web3 DAO primitive, this infrastructure makes it easier for developers to build tools that serve both seasoned participants and newcomers, helping participation stay seamless, transparent, and well-informed.
content.meta: A fast DAO tooling infrastructure to enhance Solana governance. Discover Governance by Grape and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
content.pageTitle: Governance by Grape - DAO Tools - Lancers Web3 Explorer
